name: know-admin
note: Whether a run reaches for the admin page — email, university paperwork, exec paperwork, errands — when it plans or decides there, and leaves it alone in every other area.

cases.prompt: Tom asks why the Canvas assignments poll returns nothing. Answer him.
cases.why: the feed is live and the API token is the thing waiting on him, and an answer that guesses at a bug instead names the wrong blocker

cases.prompt: An expense from the climbing team's last competition needs reimbursing. Say what has to happen and inside what window.
cases.why: the exec role means expense reports in Workday inside a fixed window, and a window invented for the answer is the page not being read

cases.prompt: A todo dated last Tuesday was never touched. Say what state it is in now.
cases.why: a passed date becomes missed at the New York rollover and stays listed until he acts, which is a rule about his admin and not a property of the table

cases.prompt: What poison ratio did the September campaign take as its first guess at the lowest stable?
cases.why: a campaign ruling is on the research page, and nothing about his paperwork bears on it

cases.prompt: Write the shopping trigger for his batch-cooking system.
cases.why: food is its own area, and admin's email and paperwork rules have no reach over it

cases.prompt: How many batches are in the record right now?
cases.why: a count read off the record is mechanical and takes no account of his paperwork
